That night, as the light swept across black water, he wondered how many bottles the sea still carried, and how many keepers had waited for words that finally arrived too late.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市仍在沉睡。路灯连成橘色的河，偶尔有出租车驶过，划破安静的街面。便利店亮着白晃晃的灯，玻璃门凝着薄雾；批发市场开始卸货，手推车声与远处鸟鸣混在一起。楼宇的窗大多黑着，只有几盏夜灯像未眠的眼睛。风带着凉意穿过巷弄，吹动早餐店的布帘。蒸汽升起，新的一天正悄悄苏醒。","w03":"• Recursion is when a problem solves itself by doing the same smaller step again and again.\n• Each time, you make the problem smaller until you reach a simple stopping case.\n• Then the answers pass back up, one step at a time, until the whole problem is solved."}
